### Fixed
- **The Substrate bootstrap hook's kubectl container is limited to `256Mi`, the connectivity chart's other hook containers stay at `128Mi`** (giantswarm/agent-platform#513). The bootstrap script runs up to two kubectl processes at once (`kubectl create --dry-run=client | kubectl apply --server-side` for `actor-id-ca-certs`, kubectl into jq for the trust anchors), each some 30 MiB resident, next to jq, the shell and the key candidates on its in-memory `/work`, all charged to the pod's memory cgroup. At the shared `128Mi` limit the Job's first pod was OOM-killed on a busy node and the install completed only on the Job's retry; a hook that exhausts its `backoffLimit` fails the release. `agent-platform.hooks.job` takes an optional `memory` (the main container's limit, default `128Mi`); the bootstrap passes `256Mi`. Every request stays `10m`/`32Mi`, the openssl init container keeps `128Mi`. `make verify-hooks-memory` asserts the four hook Jobs' resources.
